name: Fog in the trees with wind.aiff
description:
It's not rain but sounds like rain - fog and damp settling in the trees as a breeze blows. Recorded in the fields above my home in the fog and damp - so sounds amplified and 'hollow'. Recorded using a Sennheiser MKE300 'shotgun' mic. Cropped in Audacity; and saved as aif file. Rustling leaves can also be made out.

Feel free to hash it, mash it and trash it. Use it as you wish. No conditions.
